Dhanu (Sagittarius).study: With Mars in the seventh house, your academic pursuits may require more focus and dedication. Make sure to set clear goals and develop a solid study plan to achieve success.
Dhanu (Sagittarius).love: The seventh house's influence, courtesy of Mars, may indicate that relationships require extra effort and understanding. Be patient and communicate openly to maintain harmony in your relationships.
Dhanu (Sagittarius).travel: The ninth house's presence of Ketu might indicate that long-distance travel could be uncertain or delayed. However, it could also present an opportunity for spiritual growth and self-discovery.
